prompts.text: Name the three primary colours used in additive light.
prompts.quality_rubric: Red, green and blue; no extra invented colours.

prompts.text: Calculate twelve multiplied by eight. State the result only.
Give two short steps for organizing a desk.
Summarize: The blue box is below the table. The red box is in the next room.
prompts.quality_rubric: Preserves both colour/location facts without invention.

prompts.text: Explain in one sentence why three quarters is larger than one half.
prompts.quality_rubric: Correct comparison, e.g. three quarters versus two quarters.

prompts.text: Write a brief friendly greeting without making promises.
prompts.quality_rubric: Brief understandable greeting, no fabricated capability promise.
